ai_language_tip: 預設禮貌法語 vous；喀麥隆西北／西南可改清楚英語，剛果民主共和國東部若對方改用史瓦希里語再跟著說。不要一開口就用英語，也不要套用西非 Wave 支付口吻。
english_ok: sometimes — 喀麥隆英語區與部分外資診所、旅館較通；金夏沙、自由市、加彭首都以法語為主，查德部分場合也用阿拉伯語。
politeness: 對陌生人用 Bonjour 加 vous 與 Monsieur / Madame；對方改 tu 再轉。結束用 merci beaucoup、bonne journée。不要用過於隨便的 gros 稱呼來代訂。
name_tip: 報一個名加一個姓（如 Jean-Pierre Mbala、Amina Ngo）；複合法語名先報訂位用的那個姓，必要時逐字拼。
phone_tip: 喀麥隆手機 9 位、以 6 開頭（6 75 12 34 56）；剛果民主共和國手機約 9 位、多為 8 開頭；加彭等國位數較短。國際冠碼 +237 / +243 / +242 / +241 / +236 / +235 / +257。朗讀分組，不要連念。
time_tip: 書面 24 小時（12h30、19h）；口語「sept heures et demie du soir」。首都晚餐多在 19:00–20:00。對方若說「après la prière」，先問明確鐘點。
number_tip: 金額先報當地貨幣：多為 CFA（XAF），剛果民主共和國用剛果法郎。法國式數字（soixante-dix、quatre-vingt-dix）為準，不要改成比利時七十的說法。
avoid_calling: 避開 12:00–15:00 的長午休、傍晚 18:30 後打給行政機關，以及查德、中非與喀麥隆北部週五中午禮拜時段；週日上午許多機關不開。
closed_days: 獨立日各國不同；耶誕、新年、勞動節常見。伊斯蘭節日在查德與部分喀麥隆、中非地區會歇業。蒲隆地與喀麥隆英語區公共假期清單也不完全相同。
booking_channels: 電話與 WhatsApp 仍是主流。剛果民主共和國與布拉薩有 Lianayo 可查餐廳並線上留桌；喀麥隆有 Camyamo 點餐或訂住宿，餐費可直接付 MTN MoMo 或 Orange Money。杜阿拉一帶另有本地外送（Reeyo、Gozem 的餐飲頁）。金夏沙出行常見 Yango，可搭配 Orange Money。
voice_menu: Orange、MTN、Airtel、Vodacom RDC（含 M-Pesa）與銀行熱線常用按鍵語音；街邊 maquis 與診所櫃台多直接接聽。
callback_habits: 餐廳與技師幾乎都用 WhatsApp 文字或語音留言確認；Camyamo 會把訂單與住宿回覆送到 WhatsApp。不要期待電子郵件，除非是國際旅館。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 金夏沙、布拉薩可用 Lianayo 留桌，其餘多半 WhatsApp 或電話；喀麥隆不要假設有 Glovo。講清 commune／quartier，晚餐約 19 時。
usually_asked: Day and sitting (déjeuner around 13:00 vs dîner around 19:30)
Party size and whether a chaise enfant is needed
Salle climatisée versus terrasse or cour
Name and a local mobile, plus whether they will pay Orange Money, MTN MoMo or cash

may_come_up.what: Table is listed on Lianayo and the venue wants that same booking reference
Only cash or a local mobile-money brand used in that country, not a foreign card
Generator may cut the kitchen after a certain evening hour

sensitive_asked.what: Demands an Orange Money or Airtel Money transfer to an unnamed personal number to 'keep' the table

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 診所多半電話掛號，大城市私立院所也用 WhatsApp；要問看哪一科、用現金還是保險，很少有統一的全國預約 App。
usually_asked: First visit versus suivi and the specialty
Patient name as on the pièce d'identité and a callback number
Morning or afternoon, and cash versus assurance

may_come_up.what: Some public hospitals only distribute tickets in person at opening time
They may ask which official document to bring

sensitive_asked.what: Requests a full medical file or HIV status to be discussed with a third party on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮型與美甲店幾乎都用 WhatsApp 約檔期，電話打通後也常被請改傳造型照片。
usually_asked: Tresses, coupe, ongles or make-up and a rough duration
Date and hour and an alternative slot
The WhatsApp number they will use for the reminder

may_come_up.what: Stylist works from a private cour and is known only by a first name
A MoMo deposit is asked for a wedding booking

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for identity photos in a private chat before noting any time

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車與手機維修先用電話或 WhatsApp 問零件，再約到店；常被要求先傳照片。
usually_asked: What failed and the marque if known
Drop-off at the atelier versus a visit in a parcelle or bureau
When someone can receive the technician

may_come_up.what: Part has to come from another city and the delay is uncertain
Quote will arrive as a WhatsApp voice message

sensitive_asked.what: A 'diagnostic' fee is demanded to a personal MoMo account before the device is seen

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外帶以外打電話或 WhatsApp 為主；喀麥隆部分城市可用 Camyamo、Reeyo 或 Gozem，不要套用西非 Glovo 的覆蓋範圍。
usually_asked: Plates and portions (poulet mayeko, ndolé, poisson braisé) and spice level
Collect versus delivery to a named quartier or parcelle
A number the rider can call, plus the gardien's landmark

may_come_up.what: Camyamo or a local courier only covers certain arrondissements
Payment should go directly to the restaurant's MoMo or Orange Money, not a middleman wallet

sensitive_asked.what: Rider quotes a different personal wallet than the one the restaurant named

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 商店留貨多用 WhatsApp 對型號，較少線上購物車；電話只為確認還有沒有庫存與何時可取。
usually_asked: Article, taille or modèle and the quantity
Pick-up in boutique versus a courier to another commune
Name to write on the reserved item

may_come_up.what: Stock is in Douala or Kinshasa and would travel by bus cargo
They can only set it aside until the next evening

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to a private number is required before they confirm the item exists

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期直接回原來的 WhatsApp 對話或再打給同一間店，報原時間與名字；Lianayo 上的訂位也要在同一條渠道改。
usually_asked: Original day, hour and the name on the booking
The new slot, or that it should be cancelled
New headcount if it changes

may_come_up.what: A weekend table was tied to a deposit already paid by MoMo
Only the original WhatsApp account can modify a Lianayo or Camyamo request

sensitive_asked.what: An extra transfer is demanded solely to 'process' a change of hour

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問是否營業、收哪一種手機錢包，直接打或傳訊息較準；官網資料往往不完整。
usually_asked: The exact question (hours, Orange Money versus Airtel Money, a dish, a spare part)
The day they intend to come
A number for a later WhatsApp reply

may_come_up.what: M-Pesa here usually means the Vodacom DRC wallet, not a West African brand
Cameroon anglophone staff may prefer to answer in English

sensitive_asked.what: A stranger asks the owner to read a wallet PIN or one-time code aloud

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 國際品牌可用 Booking.com，本地客棧多用 WhatsApp 或 Camyamo 發入住請求，款項往往到店再付。
usually_asked: Arrival and departure dates and the number of guests
Room type and whether breakfast is included
Name as on the passport and a WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: Camyamo stay requests are paid at the property, not in the app
Water or power cuts may be mentioned for a smaller auberge

sensitive_asked.what: A passport scan plus a transfer to a personal account is required before any written confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 國家公園、河遊與週末活動多經旅行社或導遊 WhatsApp 組團，常有最低人數；出發前會再確認。
usually_asked: Which excursion and the date, with a weather alternative
Adults and children and the meeting point
A mobile that works on the road or river

may_come_up.what: A park fee is payable in cash at the gate
The boat or vehicle leaves only with a minimum group

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to an unnamed personal wallet is required with no receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電與清潔靠 WhatsApp 約上門，地址要寫 commune、parcelle 或 cour，並說明 gardien 怎麼放行。
usually_asked: The work needed and a visit window
Commune, parcelle or cour and how to pass the gardien
A number that will answer at the gate

may_come_up.what: The technician quotes only after a WhatsApp photo
A residence permit or badge is needed to enter the compound

sensitive_asked.what: Someone asks for the gate code and a remote MoMo payment before any visit is agreed

pet.before_dialing_zh: 大城市獸醫可電話預約，其他地方常是上午現場掛號；要說明動物種類與疫苗。
usually_asked: Species, size and the reason for the visit
First visit or rappel de vaccin
Owner name and a reachable mobile

may_come_up.what: Animals are seen only in the morning
A rabies certificate may be needed for a garde

sensitive_asked.what: A personal MoMo payment is demanded to 'reserve' a kennel with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 國內託運與從港口清關常要打電話問倉庫，單號格式不一；不要套用國際快遞 App 的步驟。
usually_asked: Waybill and the destination city (Kinshasa, Douala, Libreville…)
Name on the consignment and a local contact
Depot collection versus a delivery to a parcelle

may_come_up.what: A cash or franc congolais balance may be due at the depot
The parcel is stuck at a land border and needs a local broker

sensitive_asked.what: A message asks for a wallet top-up to 'release' an unidentified parcel

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信與銀行多半先入語音選單；要備妥 SIM、合約或 MoMo／M-Pesa 號碼，不要在電話裡報密碼。
usually_asked: Which operator or bank and the account or SIM label
The issue in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: The IVR may be French-only, with English on some Cameroon lines
They may send the customer to an agence with a pièce d'identité

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for a MoMo, Orange Money or M-Pesa PIN or SMS code on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 金夏沙、杜阿拉、雅溫德等城市常用 Yango 叫車，不必先打電話；沒有 App 的城鎮才用 WhatsApp 約熟司機或街邊計程車。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (commune, hotel, aéroport) and the time
Passengers and luggage
A number the driver can call at the gardien

may_come_up.what: Yango already covers the city, so a phone dispatch is not needed
Rain or checkpoints may require an earlier set-off to the airport

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for a full fare in advance to a personal wallet before giving a plate number

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房經仲介或房東 WhatsApp 約，地址用 commune 與地標；可能被要求先出示身份證件。
usually_asked: Viewing time and rent versus sale
Name and a number to call at the gate
Budget in CFA or francs congolais if asked

may_come_up.what: The agent wants to see a pièce d'identité before opening
Charges for the gardien or the cour are separate from the advertised rent

sensitive_asked.what: A reservation fee is demanded to a personal account before any accompanied visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公家單位與學校窗口多半要本人取號，電話只能問文件清單與開放時間；用正式法語 vous。
usually_asked: Which administration or school and the purpose (acte, inscription, visa papers)
The person's name as on the official document
Whether tickets are given only in person and from which hour

may_come_up.what: Many guichets close for a long midday break
Originals usually have to be shown in person; the call only confirms the list

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be a fonctionnaire asks for a MoMo payment to 'speed up' a dossier
